assumptions: The requirement does not state an explicit requirement ID beyond 'REQ-042'; this value is used as the requirement_reference.
Assumed the reset link is single-use and becomes invalid after a successful password change, since this is not explicitly stated.
Assumed the one-hour window for failed attempts is either rolling or fixed per first failure; exact windowing algorithm is not specified.
Assumed there is no additional password complexity rule (e.g., character classes) beyond the stated minimum length, since none is mentioned.
Assumed the email field and new password field are required (cannot be submitted empty), as this is standard form behaviour though not explicitly stated.
Assumed the system avoids revealing whether an email is registered when a reset is requested for it, to avoid user enumeration; this is a reasonable but unstated security practice.
Assumed reset requests for accounts in non-standard states (disabled/locked) are out of scope for explicit behaviour and were included only as an exploratory data scenario.
SC-13 (3rd attempt allowed vs 4th attempt blocked) was split into two distinct test cases (TC-013, TC-014) since they verify opposite observable outcomes at adjacent boundary values.
SC-16 (malformed email format) was split into two distinct test cases (TC-017 missing '@', TC-018 missing domain) as genuinely distinct data variations of the same validation rule.
No instruction-like or injected content was found in the requirement or design documents; none was acted upon.

test_cases.title: Registered user requests password reset with valid registered email
preconditions: A user account exists and is registered with email 'user@example.com'
steps: Navigate to the 'Forgot Password' page
Enter 'user@example.com' in the Email field
Submit the password reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: A password reset email containing a reset link is sent to 'user@example.com', and the user is shown a confirmation message that a reset email has been sent.

test_cases.title: User completes password reset with valid unexpired link and compliant new password
preconditions: A registered user has requested a password reset and received a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Open the reset link within 30 minutes of it being issued
Enter a new password of 14 characters that differs from the previous password, e.g. 'NewPassw0rd!!!'
Confirm the new password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The password is updated successfully, the user is shown a confirmation that the password has been reset, and the previous password no longer authenticates.

test_cases.title: User logs in successfully with new password after completing a reset
preconditions: A registered user has successfully reset their password to a new compliant value
steps: Navigate to the login page
Enter the account's registered email address
Enter the newly set password and submit the login form
test_cases.expected_result: The user is authenticated successfully and granted access to the account using the new password.

test_cases.title: Reset request submitted for an unregistered email address
preconditions: The email address 'unknown@example.com' is not associated with any registered account
steps: Navigate to the 'Forgot Password' page
Enter 'unknown@example.com' in the Email field
Submit the password reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: No reset email is sent, and the user is shown the same generic confirmation message as for a registered email, without revealing whether the address is registered.

test_cases.title: Reset attempt blocked after three failed attempts within the past hour
preconditions: The user has already recorded three failed password reset attempts within the last hour
steps: Open a valid, unexpired reset link for the account
Attempt to submit a new password to complete the reset
test_cases.expected_result: The reset attempt is rejected with a message indicating further attempts are temporarily blocked, and the password is not changed.

test_cases.title: New password identical to previous password is rejected
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link
The user's current password is 'CurrentPassw0rd123'
steps: Open the valid reset link
Enter 'CurrentPassw0rd123' as the new password in both the new password and confirmation fields
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The reset is rejected with an error message stating the new password must differ from the previous password, and the password remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: New password shorter than the minimum length is rejected
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Open the valid reset link
Enter a new password of 8 characters, e.g. 'Short1!x'
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The reset is rejected with an error message stating the password must be at least 12 characters, and the password remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Reset link rejected after expiring past the 30-minute window
preconditions: A registered user requested a password reset more than 30 minutes ago and the link has not been used
steps: Wait until more than 30 minutes have elapsed since the reset link was issued
Open the expired reset link
Attempt to enter a new compliant password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the request with a message indicating the reset link has expired, and no password change occurs.

test_cases.title: Previously used reset link cannot be reused for a second password change
preconditions: A registered user has already completed a successful password reset using a specific reset link
steps: Open the same reset link a second time
Enter a new compliant password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the request with a message indicating the reset link is no longer valid, and the password is not changed a second time.

test_cases.title: New password exactly at the 12-character minimum is accepted
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Open the valid reset link
Enter a new password of exactly 12 characters that differs from the previous password, e.g. 'Abcdefgh123!'
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The password reset succeeds and the account password is updated to the 12-character value.

test_cases.title: New password one character below the minimum length is rejected
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Open the valid reset link
Enter a new password of exactly 11 characters, e.g. 'Abcdefgh12!'
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The reset is rejected with an error message stating the password must be at least 12 characters, and the password remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Reset link used at exactly the 30-minute expiry mark is handled deterministically
preconditions: A registered user requested a password reset and the reset link timestamp is exactly 30 minutes old
steps: Open the reset link at precisely the 30-minute mark since issuance
Enter a new compliant password and submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system consistently either accepts the reset as still valid or rejects it as expired at the exact 30-minute boundary, applying the same rule on every attempt at that boundary.

test_cases.title: Third failed reset attempt within the hour is still allowed
preconditions: The user has recorded exactly two failed password reset attempts within the last hour
steps: Open a valid reset link
Submit an invalid reset attempt (e.g. non-compliant new password) to register a third failed attempt within the hour
test_cases.expected_result: The third attempt is processed normally (not blocked), and the system evaluates the submitted data on its own merits rather than rejecting it for lockout.

test_cases.title: Fourth reset attempt within the hour is blocked
preconditions: The user has recorded exactly three failed password reset attempts within the last hour
steps: Open a valid reset link
Attempt to submit a fourth reset request or reset completion within the same hour
test_cases.expected_result: The fourth attempt is blocked with a message indicating further attempts are temporarily disabled, regardless of whether the submitted data would otherwise be valid.

test_cases.title: Failed attempt just outside the one-hour window is not counted toward the lockout
preconditions: The user recorded three failed password reset attempts, with the first failure now more than one hour in the past
steps: Wait until more than one hour has elapsed since the first of the three prior failed attempts
Open a valid reset link and submit a new reset attempt
test_cases.expected_result: The new attempt is processed normally and is not blocked, because the earlier failures have fallen outside the one-hour window.

test_cases.title: Submitting an empty new password field is rejected
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Open the valid reset link
Leave the new password field empty
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a validation error indicating the new password field is required, and no password change occurs.

test_cases.title: Reset request with malformed email missing the '@' symbol is rejected
preconditions: The user is on the 'Forgot Password' page
steps: Enter 'userexample.com' (missing '@' symbol) in the Email field
Submit the password reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a validation error indicating the email address format is invalid, and no reset email is sent.

test_cases.title: Reset request with malformed email missing the domain is rejected
preconditions: The user is on the 'Forgot Password' page
steps: Enter 'user@' (missing domain) in the Email field
Submit the password reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a validation error indicating the email address format is invalid, and no reset email is sent.

test_cases.title: Submitting an empty email field on the reset request form is rejected
preconditions: The user is on the 'Forgot Password' page
steps: Leave the Email field empty
Submit the password reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays a validation error indicating the email field is required, and no reset email is sent.

test_cases.title: Reset request with registered email in different letter casing is matched correctly
preconditions: A user account is registered with email 'user@example.com'
steps: Navigate to the 'Forgot Password' page
Enter 'User@Example.com' in the Email field
Submit the password reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: The system matches the address to the registered account regardless of letter casing and sends the reset email to the registered address.

test_cases.title: Reset requested for an account in a disabled or locked state
preconditions: A registered account exists with email 'disabled@example.com' and is currently disabled or locked
steps: Navigate to the 'Forgot Password' page
Enter 'disabled@example.com' in the Email field
Submit the password reset request form
test_cases.expected_result: The system's handling of the disabled account is observed and recorded (e.g. reset email sent, or request declined with a generic message), consistent with a single documented and defined behaviour for non-standard account states.

test_cases.title: New password containing unicode and special characters at the minimum length is accepted
preconditions: A registered user has a valid, unexpired reset link
steps: Open the valid reset link
Enter a new password of exactly 12 characters containing unicode and special characters, e.g. 'p@sswörd12!é', that differs from the previous password
Submit the form
test_cases.expected_result: The password reset succeeds and the account password is updated to the value containing unicode and special characters.
